data.headline: You're not lazy
data.subheadline: Your brain just hates uncertainty more than effort

data.context: People procrastinate not because they're lazy, but because uncertain outcomes trigger anxiety
data.takeaway: Your brain would rather do nothing than risk doing the wrong thing

data.myth: Procrastination means you're unmotivated or lazy
data.fact: Procrastination is an emotional regulation problem, not a time management problem
data.proof: Studies show procrastinators often care MORE about the task — the fear of failure paralyzes them

data.callToAction: What task are you avoiding right now?

manifest.caption:
You're not lazy.

Your brain is just trying to protect you from uncertainty.

Procrastination = emotional regulation.

Not a character flaw.

What are you avoiding today?

sourceArticle.title: The Science Behind Why We Procrastinate
